primaryBeforeKeys: Along each horizontal ideal streamline, static plus dynamic pressure is conserved. Absolute pressure ratios require the declared reference; positive speed inverses use the positive root and the liquid remains explicitly monophase. A and B may have different compatible areas and energy constants.

propertyAudit.coverage: Integer branch counts and exact volume reconstruction; two-outlet mass balance; tracer mixing convexity and common scaling; pressure-work rate and SI conversion; Bernoulli energy equality and compatible section areas. Separate tests cover strict domains, excluded phase states, redundant scales, nonlinear means and exact calibrations.

records.assetReview: A rectangular conduit with fixed 1 cm depth has inlet/outlet heights 2 and 1 cm, drawn 100 and 50 px at 50 px/cm. Areas 2 and 1 cm² give common Q = 0.4 L/s at 2 and 4 m/s. Separate speed arrows 80 and 160 px use 40 px/(m/s). Pressure bars all use 3 px/kPa: A inlet 300 + 6 = 306 px, A outlet 282 + 24 = 306; B inlet 300 + 24 = 324, B outlet 318 + 6 = 324. Constants are conserved within A or B separately, not across the two trials. Complete XML, marker definitions and full native rendering read.
records.distractors: 106 reverses the kinetic difference, 110 adds both dynamic pressures, and 6 is only the pressure drop. Continuity requires A₁ = 2 A₂ here.
records.manualArithmetic: At rho = 1000 kg/m³, the dynamic contributions for 2 and 4 m/s are 2 and 8 kPa. Conservation gives p₂ = 100 + 2 − 8 = 94 kPa.
records.physicalAssumptions: Ideal incompressible steady liquid along the same horizontal streamline within each trial, no loss or machine, uniform one-dimensional velocity profiles, explicit monophase liquid assumption. rho = 1000 kg/m³, p₁ = 100 kPa absolute, positive speeds and final absolute pressure. Positive pressure alone is not a universal real-fluid phase criterion; the assigned monophase condition remains additional. Areas obey A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ and may change between separate trials; Bernoulli constants need not match across trials.

reviewSequence: All 80 original U3-03 prompts 095–099 were read individually from pinned Git before original or candidate keys, alternatives or solutions. Primary laws, all numerical results, inverse branches, units and domains were recorded first. Then every candidate prompt, alternative, full solution and formula, hint, feedback, metadata and provenance was read. All five SVG files were read completely in XML and full native images. Final 096-16 text from 3089d1d was reread before freezing. Root package and binding bytes were compared with each read author commit before signatures were written.
